summary: Backend testing of ERP Agricola FastAPI app. 21/21 pytest cases passed covering auth, users, plantaciones, tipos/variedades fruta, cosechas (with date filters), asignaciones-destino (cesta<->kg conversion via KG_POR_CESTA=14), compras (with es_equipo auto-creating an equipo row), aplicaciones with insumos, inventario aggregation, actividades (horas_hombre auto-calc), ventas finca/ciudad, frio-registros, trabajadores and analiticas/resumen.

minor.issue: CORSMiddleware uses allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; browsers will block credentialed (cookie) requests. Cookie-based auth works only when explicit origin is set. Token (Bearer) flow works fine, but cookie SSO from frontend may fail. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/frontend origin.
Cookie is set with secure=False; on HTTPS preview this still works but in production over HTTPS, secure=True is recommended.
MODULOS_DISPONIBLES is referenced inside /api/auth/create-admin (defined later but resolved at call-time, so it works). Not a bug, just code-organization smell.

action_items: Consider tightening CORS by setting CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit preview URL instead of '*' to allow cookie-based auth from the React app.
Optional: set cookie secure=True (since preview is HTTPS) and samesite='none' if cross-site cookie auth is desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Single-file server.py (~900 lines) - acceptable for MVP but should be split into routers (auth, plantaciones, cosechas, etc.) if it grows further.
_id field exposed as UUID string (not ObjectId) - safe, JSON-serializable.
Bcrypt hash format verified ($2b$) and seed_admin updates password on env change (matches playbook).
No brute-force lockout implemented - flagged for future hardening (not blocking).
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed records (TEST_Plant_1, TEST_Aguacate/TEST_Hass, TEST_Urea compra+aplicacion, TEST_Tractor_X equipo, TEST_Worker, plus a cosecha 2026-01-15). Records left in DB for future iterations; no cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend 100% green. If retesting, note that TEST_Urea exists in inventario with total_comprado=100, total_enviado=10 from prior run; running tests again will increase those numbers but assertions use >= so they remain valid for some but inventario_aggregation uses ==; consider cleaning erp_agricola DB or adjusting assertions if re-running.
